headline: DPSC Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process Initiated; Creditor List Published
sum: DPSC Limited has entered CIRP under the IBC, with the Corporate Debtor mandated to publish the list of creditors on the NSE as required under IBBI Regulations. The creditor intimation filing marks formal disclosure of the insolvency proceedings.
detail: DPSC Limited, a listed corporate debtor, has filed a mandatory intimation with the NSE under Regulation 13(2)(c) of the IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016, disclosing the list of creditors as required in corporate insolvency proceedings. This filing confirms the company is in formal CIRP, with the Insolvency Professional (IP) or Interim Resolution Professional (IRP) managing the estate. The creditor list is a central statutory document in IBC proceedings, serving as the basis for creditor voting on resolution plans and claims adjudication.
